_doc: Cultivation realms in order. qi_required(stage) = qi_base * qi_growth^stage. base_qi_per_day is the rate for a 1.0x character in a 1.0 density area. breakthrough_chance / failure_qi_loss apply when breaking INTO this realm from the previous realm's final stage. description (C-084): one or two sentences of genre voice about what the realm means to a cultivator, no numbers, under 220 characters; every realm needs one. Balance rule (F-005b, enforced by test_data): the lifespan gained by entering the next realm must be at least 10x Cultivation.expected_realm_years for this realm at a 1.0x cultivator, so a sensible cultivator almost never dies of old age. tribulation (optional): a Heavenly Tribulation summoned when a breakthrough INTO this realm succeeds (Tribulation system): waves lightning waves, the first striking with attack = this realm's combat power (Combat.realm_power at stage 0) * strength, each next one * growth, resisted by defense like a combat blow, each rolled at +-variance; the strongest readied shield talisman absorbs damage first, at tribulation_shield_scale (top level, 0..1) of its combat value, or its own items.json combat.tribulation for purpose-made wards (TRIB-001d); only one ward counts and only it burns. Falling before the final wave fails the breakthrough (failure_qi_loss + a tribulation_failure injury from injuries.json); falling to the final wave kills (the Creation Artifact may respawn the player). npc_strength (optional, QA-010): the strength NPCs face instead (they carry no modelled techniques or gear), tuned so a generated NPC survives about as often as a typical player (tests/sim/simulate_tribulation.gd). failure_bonus / failure_bonus_max (FOUND-003, top level): each failed breakthrough attempt (including a failed tribulation) adds failure_bonus to the next attempt's chance, up to failure_bonus_max in total; a success resets it; need 0 <= failure_bonus <= failure_bonus_max <= 0.5. heart_demon: characters with alignment <= max_alignment face an extra wave just before the final one dealing max_hp * hp_fraction * (how demonic they are, 0..1), ignoring defense. heart_vision (HEART-001, optional, on the realm broken INTO, Foundation upward): {text, choices: 2-4 of {label, bonus, text, check?: {attribute, target}, fail_bonus?, fail_text?}}. Shown once per realm per life before a major breakthrough; the chosen bonus (-0.15..0.15) joins the next attempt's odds and is spent by it. A check (same shape as an encounter choice's) rolls Exploration.check_chance; failing gives fail_bonus/fail_text instead (only with a check). a choice may also have min_alignment / max_alignment (ints within data/alignment.json bounds, min <= max; HEART-002): outside the range it is hidden, and a vision with no visible choice is skipped; alignment (int, optional) shifts the player's alignment when that choice is faced. At most 6 choices; every alignment must see 2-4. text may use {rival_or_parent}: the player's rival, else 'a faceless figure'.

realms.name: Mortal
realms.description: A body of flesh and bone, bound to the dust of the world. The Dao has not yet noticed you, but the first spark of qi waits to be found.

realms.name: Qi Refining
realms.description: You draw the world's qi into your meridians and learn to hold it. Nine layers of patient labor separate the villager from the true cultivator.

realms.name: Foundation Establishment
realms.description: Your scattered qi settles into a foundation as firm as bedrock. Mortals now call you immortal, and the sects begin to take your name seriously.

heart_vision.text: As your qi settles, the face of {rival_or_parent} rises in your mind, mocking every step you took to get here.

choices.label: Face it and let it pass
choices.text: The face thins like mist and your breath evens.
choices.fail_text: It lingers, and your breath trembles.

choices.label: Crush it with will
choices.text: Your will cracks the vision like thin ice.
choices.fail_text: The face laughs, and your will wavers.

choices.label: Ignore it and push on
choices.text: You push past, neither steadier nor shaken.

choices.label: Embrace the hunger
choices.text: The hunger roars through you and bends to your will.
choices.fail_text: The hunger gnaws at you and leaves you shaking.

choices.label: Swear a vow to the righteous path
choices.text: Your vow settles in your chest like a lit lamp.
choices.fail_text: The vow comes out thin, and the face smirks.

realms.name: Core Formation
realms.description: Your qi condenses into a golden core, a seed of the Dao within the dantian. Heaven sends its first tribulation to test whether you deserve it.

heart_vision.text: In the stillness before the core forms, every wish you buried returns, whispering that you could still turn back.

choices.label: Name each wish and release it
choices.text: One by one the whispers go quiet.
choices.fail_text: A wish you could not name clings to you.

choices.label: Hold fast to your Dao
choices.text: Your Dao rings clear and the whispers fall away.
choices.fail_text: Your Dao shivers, and doubt seeps in.

choices.label: Let them whisper
choices.text: You let the voices pass unanswered.

choices.label: Feed on the longing
choices.text: You swallow every wish whole, and are stronger for it.
choices.fail_text: The wishes devour you in turn.

choices.label: Renew your oath
choices.text: You speak the oath again and it holds.
choices.fail_text: The oath rings, but you doubt your own voice.

realms.name: Nascent Soul
realms.description: A tiny infant of pure spirit is born from your core and can leave the body behind. Elders of great sects bow to few, but they bow to you.

heart_vision.text: Your nascent soul stirs and shows you your own face, older and colder, asking what you will trade for eternity.

choices.label: Answer it honestly
choices.text: Your answer is true, and the soul settles.
choices.fail_text: Your answer rings hollow, and the soul recoils.

choices.label: Meet its gaze without a word
choices.text: It reads what you did not say and bows its head.
choices.fail_text: It reads too much, and you flinch.

choices.label: Turn away from it
choices.text: You turn away, and the soul keeps its counsel.

choices.label: Devour its doubt
choices.text: You swallow the soul's doubt and it becomes your strength.
choices.fail_text: The soul bites back, and you reel.

choices.label: Vow to protect the weak
choices.text: The soul smiles at an answer worth the eternity.
choices.fail_text: The soul sees how little you have yet done.

realms.name: Soul Formation
realms.description: Body and soul grow strong enough to bear the weight of heaven and earth. Where you stand, the very rules of the world begin to listen.

heart_vision.text: Your soul splits into reflections, each one certain it is the true you, each one reaching for the same breath.

choices.label: Call every reflection home
choices.text: The reflections fold into you like returning birds.
choices.fail_text: One reflection refuses to return and walks away with a piece of you.

choices.label: Pick the one that is truly you
choices.text: You name the true self, and the rest fade without protest.
choices.fail_text: You choose wrongly, and the others mourn it.

choices.label: Let them all wander
choices.text: The reflections drift apart and back again, and you take no side.

choices.label: Devour the weaker souls
choices.text: You swallow the lesser reflections and feel their strength settle in your bones.
choices.fail_text: The reflections claw at you from inside and leave you shaking.

choices.label: Share your breath with each one
choices.text: Every reflection receives its share, and none is left hungry.
choices.fail_text: You spread yourself too thin, and the shares come back unequal.

realms.name: Void Refinement
realms.description: You step between the cracks of reality and bend the void to your will. Distance, hiding and even the sky feel thin to you.

heart_vision.text: The void opens beneath your feet, vast and patient, and it asks nothing at all, which is the hardest question.

choices.label: Step into the emptiness
choices.text: The void holds you as a hand holds water, and you do not sink.
choices.fail_text: The void tilts, and you scramble back to the edge.

choices.label: Study the silence
choices.text: In the silence you hear the shape of the Dao, and it is simple.
choices.fail_text: The silence is only silence, and it wears at you.

choices.label: Refuse to look down
choices.text: You keep your eyes on the horizon, and the void lets you pass.

choices.label: Feed the void your fears
choices.text: The void drinks your fears and leaves you hard and clear.
choices.fail_text: The void drinks too much, and you stagger hollow.

choices.label: Fill the void with compassion
choices.text: A small light burns in the dark, and the void bends around it.
choices.fail_text: Your light gutters, and the dark presses close.

realms.name: Body Integration
realms.description: Flesh, soul and Dao fuse into one, and your body becomes a vessel of the heavens. Few in the mortal world can even see your shadow.

heart_vision.text: Your body unfolds into a world, with mountains for bones, rivers for blood and weather in every breath, and you are its only sky.

choices.label: Walk your body from end to end
choices.text: Every mountain knows your tread, and the rivers run steady.
choices.fail_text: A fault line opens under you, and the world shudders.

choices.label: Name each part and bind it
choices.text: Each name takes hold, and the world answers to you.
choices.fail_text: A part you cannot name goes wild.

choices.label: Leave the world to its weather
choices.text: The storms pass over your body, and nothing is lost or gained.

choices.label: Make the world a hunting ground
choices.text: Your body becomes a place where everything weaker is prey, and it makes you strong.
choices.fail_text: The hunt turns on you, and your own world bites back.

choices.label: Make the world a shelter
choices.text: Your body becomes a warm valley, and the heavens notice.
choices.fail_text: The shelter is too small for what you carry, and it shakes.

realms.name: Mahayana
realms.description: You have walked nearly to the end of the road, a Great Vehicle carrying all your understanding. Only the final tribulation stands between you and the heavens.

heart_vision.text: The Great Vehicle waits at the edge of your sight, wide enough to carry every living thing, and it has room for you only if you choose who rides.

choices.label: Carry everyone who asks
choices.text: The vehicle swells to hold them all, and you do not tire.
choices.fail_text: The crowd is too heavy, and you set it down shaken.

choices.label: Ask where it is going
choices.text: The answer is the Dao itself, and you laugh at how plain it is.
choices.fail_text: The answer is a riddle, and you wear yourself guessing.

choices.label: Stay on the shore
choices.text: You watch it sail past, and you are neither poorer nor wiser.

choices.label: Take the vehicle for yourself
choices.text: You seize the helm and the whole vessel bends to you alone.
choices.fail_text: The vehicle bucks and throws you down hard.

choices.label: Give up your seat for another
choices.text: Your seat is taken, and a greater one opens beneath you.
choices.fail_text: Nobody takes it, and you stand a long while in the cold.

realms.name: Tribulation Transcendence
realms.description: The last lightning gathers over your head. Survive it and you leave the mortal world behind; fail and all you were is ash on the wind.

heart_vision.text: Heaven's judgement gathers overhead and weighs every day you have lived, and the scale does not care which way you hope it tips.

choices.label: Stand and be judged
choices.text: The scale holds still, and you walk out under it unbowed.
choices.fail_text: The scale shivers, and you feel every debt at once.

choices.label: Read the verdict before it falls
choices.text: You read the law behind the thunder and step aside from its edge.
choices.fail_text: You read it wrong, and the thunder finds you.

choices.label: Bow your head and wait
choices.text: The judgement passes over a bowed head, and gives nothing.

choices.label: Defy the heavens
choices.text: You raise your fist at the sky, and it blinks first.
choices.fail_text: The sky answers, and your fist is the first thing to break.

choices.label: Offer your merit in judgement
choices.text: The scale tips toward the lives you eased, and the thunder softens.
choices.fail_text: Your merit seems small against the sky, and the scale does not move.
